summary: Completed comprehensive security and optimization testing for Mishant Gandhi Portfolio. All security features working correctly: security headers, rate limiting (3/min on contact), input validation, XSS sanitization with bleach, CORS restriction. Fixed missing maxLength attributes on React contact form inputs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security optimization testing complete. All features verified: (1) Security headers present on all API responses (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-XSS-Protection), (2) Rate limiting working on /api/contact (3/min), (3) Input validation working - invalid emails return 422, oversized inputs rejected, (4) XSS sanitization with bleach working - script tags cleaned, (5) WebP image with PNG fallback working, (6) LinkedIn FAB above WhatsApp FAB, (7) All LinkedIn links point to mishantgandhi (not old camishant), (8) Request My CV button removed, (9) Standalone HTML has all security features including sanitize() function and maxlength attributes, (10) React contact form now has maxLength attributes (fixed during testing).
